_comentario: Datos de origen para tools/gen_palabras.py --libro firstwords («First Words», ver notes/06-first-words.md). Este fichero SÍ se edita a mano; content/firstwords/generated-*.tex NO. Trimestre 2 (invierno), días 66-130: dos palabras al día; llegan dos o tres letras para un sonido (sh, ch, th, ng, ai, ee, igh, oa, oo, ar, or, ur, ow, oi, ear, air, ure, er) y el resto de consonantes dobles (bb, dd, mm, nn, pp, rr, tt). Palabras de hasta cuatro sonidos, todavía sin dos consonantes seguidas.

actividad.prompt: In the living room, three Kings stand on a shelf. Every night they move a little closer, but nobody knows who moves them! Colour the three Kings.
Sam hanging up a big red sock for Father Christmas. He is sure that he is very good!
Lucía at the window, waiting for the Three Kings.

actividad.adivinanza: I am made of paper. You write me, you put me in an envelope, and the postman brings me to your door. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Colour a paper snowflake with six points, like Lucía's.
On Christmas Eve, Lucía's family has dinner at Grandma Rosa's flat. On the table, there are two red candles and a big fish. Colour it!
Everyone pulls a Christmas cracker: bang! Colour the cracker, and draw what comes out of it.
Mr Brown, the cook, with his Christmas pudding: dark brown, with a little green leaf on top.
Colour the Christmas lunch next door: the tree, Pip's cage on the little table, and Toby under the table.
Happy New Year! In Spain, people eat twelve grapes when the clock goes “Dong!” at midnight. Colour Lucía's family with their bowls of grapes.
fireworks at midnight -- boom! -- and Toby hiding under the bed.
Lucía's New Year wish: a book in English that she can read on her own.

actividad.adivinanza: Two socks, two shoes, two mittens: two things that go together. What are they?

actividad.prompt: Colour Lucía making her New Year wish on a shooting star. What is your wish?
Dani writes to the Kings: “Dear Kings, I want a torch, so I can read in bed.” And here he is, reading with his torch! Colour him.
The King cake is round like a ring. Colour it, and draw a red cherry on top.
the little king that Amy finds inside the King cake.
Colour the Three Kings' parade: a King on his camel, throwing sweets.
Snow! It is chilly, so Lucía puts on her warm red boots. Colour her boots, and the snowman in the playground.
Amy in her warm coat, throwing snowballs in the playground.
Lucía and Amy's chubby snowman, with Dad's old black hat and Mum's red scarf.

actividad.adivinanza: I am brown, I love the snow, and I try to catch the snowflakes with my mouth. When I come inside, I am white and wet! Who am I?

actividad.prompt: Colour the snowman in the garden, with his hat and his scarf.
Dani has got a cold, so he stays in bed with a hot water bottle and his toy dinosaur. Colour him in bed, with Toby on the rug.
Dani sips his medicine, a cure for his cold. It tastes of strawberries! Colour him, and draw a big strawberry next to the bottle.
Sam's card for Dani on the desk, and Dani's slippers under the chair.
Colour the things that help Dani feel better: hot soup, orange juice, a flower and Sam's card.
It is Peace Day at school. Marta's class paints a big white dove with its wings open and a green leaf in its beak. Colour it.
Lucía wants to play tag, but Amy wants to skip. Look: they are both a bit angry!
Lucía at dinner, feeling sad because she is angry with Amy.

actividad.adivinanza: When two friends are not angry any more, they say sorry and put their arms round each other. What do they give each other?

actividad.prompt: Lucía and Amy are friends again! Colour them skipping together.
At the museum, there is a dinosaur that is longer than a bus! It has got a very long neck and a very long tail. Colour it.
A Tyrannosaurus rex has got big teeth and very short arms. Colour it, and draw its big teeth!
the museum shop: Sam's new cap with a dinosaur on it, and Dani's book about dinosaurs.
Colour a Stegosaurus, with the plates on its back and the spikes on its tail.
It is Carnival! Lucía is a detective, with a long coat and a checked cap, and Amy is a green parrot. Colour their costumes.
the Carnival party in the playground: Dani is the head of a dragon, and Sam is its tail!
Pancake Day: a grown-up adds a little butter to a hot pan.

actividad.adivinanza: Mr Brown makes pancakes. When one side is golden, he throws the pancake up in the air, and it comes down on its back. What does he do to it?

actividad.prompt: Colour a Carnival mask, with feathers and spots. What costume would you like to wear?
It is very windy, so Dad takes the children to the hill. His big red and yellow kite flies higher than the trees! Colour it.
Amy and Sam's kite is shaped like a fish. Colour it, and draw its long tail.
Dad's hat flying away in the wind, and Toby running after it!
Colour a kite, flying high in the wind.
At the library, Lucía finds a book in English about a girl who lives on a boat. Colour the girl and her boat.
Lucía and Amy with their library books. They can keep them for two weeks!
Lucía reading on the sofa, and Amy lying on the rug. Hush!

actividad.adivinanza: At the library, there is a quiz. Lucía knows all the answers, and she gets a gold medal! What does she do?

actividad.prompt: Colour the cover of a book: a castle and a dragon. What book would you like to read?
Marta's class is going to grow beans. Each child puts wet cotton wool and two beans in a cup. Colour Lucía's cup.
The shoot goes up! Colour the bean and its green shoot, and draw its roots going down.
the beans on the window sill, in the sun.
Colour Lucía planting her bean in Dad's garden, with Toby digging next to her. She calls her plant Jack!
It is nearly spring! There are five yellow flowers, and a bee is looking for them. Colour them.
Jack, Lucía's bean plant, in the soil of Dad's garden. It has got four leaves now!
a red ladybird with seven black dots. Ladybirds bring good luck!

actividad.adivinanza: I am green, I live in a cage, and when I see a butterfly, I say all my words: “Hello! Toby! Biscuit!” Then I sing a long song. Who am I?

actividad.prompt: Colour the best things about this winter: the snow, the snowman, and all the friends together!
